subject.title: Implement reserve for Xiaomi MiMo plan

question: Should CodexBar continue to require authoritative Xiaomi cadence/reset evidence for MiMo reserve text, or intentionally adopt a documented monthly-only heuristic despite annual-plan ambiguity?
rationale: The available API shape cannot distinguish monthly from annual plans safely, and choosing whether to display an approximate pacing claim is a product-trust decision rather than a mechanical parser repair.

options.title: Preserve fail-closed behavior
options.body: Keep reserve and deficit text absent until a start, duration, cadence, or token-reset contract is available from Xiaomi.

options.title: Approve a bounded heuristic
options.body: Define the exact eligibility rule, user-facing uncertainty wording, annual-plan fallback, and regression cases before implementing monthly-only pacing.

recommendation.title: Preserve fail-closed behavior
recommendation.body: Keep reserve and deficit text absent until a start, duration, cadence, or token-reset contract is available from Xiaomi.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored the merged evidence contract and explicitly requested maintainer sign-off for this remaining choice.
